units.source_text: 快到码头，舞女蹲在岸边的倩影赫然映入我的眼帘。

en.t: As we neared the pier, the lovely figure of the dancer crouching by the shore suddenly came into view.

units.source_text: 我们走到她身边以前，她一动不动，只顾默默地把头耷拉下来。

en.t: Until we reached her side, she did not move at all, only silently hanging her head.

units.source_text: 她依旧是昨晚那副化了妆的模样，这就更加牵动我的情思。

en.t: She still looked as she had the night before, with her makeup on, and that stirred my feelings all the more.

units.source_text: 眼角的胭脂给她的秀脸添了几分天真，严肃的神情显出像在生气的样子。

en.t: The rouge at the corners of her eyes added a touch of innocence to her beautiful face, while her solemn expression made her seem almost angry.
